input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Sparkling. The only uses of "exclusive" are the non-exclusive licence grants (§ 2 and the escrow licence in § 16), the exclusive-remedy provision in § 15 and the non-exclusive jurisdiction clause — none restricts our freedom to source software, maintenance or related services elsewhere. The restrictions in § 3 are ordinary licence-scope limits (no copying, reverse engineering, sublicensing) and contain no requirements-purchase or "shall not procure from any third party" covenant, and § 10 maintenance/§ 11 fees do not make Garman our sole provider. Searches for "sole", "requirements from", "competing" and "third party" returned nothing of that character. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer), so no redline is required.
